design_read: Synthetic direction: read by setting the buyer checklist above the fold and pushing CTA into a compact split.
selection_rationale: Two reference_composed_v1 references were selected so the design covers the hero typography, section order, CTA, motion, and mobile axes without duplicating any axis.

adopted_principles: Keep the headline short and one-sentence.
Place a tight disclosure under the H1.
Use a single inline decision CTA.
Keep the closing manifesto free of fixed or floating CTA primitives.

prohibited_elements: Animated arrow inside the CTA label.
